steps.name: Demo Home
steps.goal: Reach Home. Dismiss Apple Account Verification with Not Now if shown. Accept the AI data notice for this isolated demo fixture if shown.

steps.name: Finding starts with source settings
steps.goal: Wait for the finding opened from its notification route.
steps.done: The finding shows the source agent, model and effort in its session control.
expect: 3 PRs waiting on review for over a day
Session agent Claude, Sonnet. Change agent or model

steps.name: Open session controls
steps.goal: Tap the element labelled Session agent Claude, Sonnet. Change agent or model.
steps.done: The existing phone agent picker offers both configured agents.

steps.name: Switch to Codex
steps.goal: Tap Codex agent once. Do not tap Done yet.
steps.done: Codex is selected and the model control shows a Codex model.

steps.name: Choose a Codex model
steps.goal: Tap the Model control labelled Change model to open the model list.
steps.done: The model list offers the Codex models.

steps.name: Select GPT-6 Astra
steps.goal: Tap GPT-6 Astra in the model list.
steps.done: The picker returns to its main page and shows the selected model.

steps.name: Apply session choices
steps.goal: Tap Done to close the agent picker.
steps.done: The finding now shows Codex and the chosen model.
expect: Session agent Codex, GPT-6 Astra. Change agent or model
forbid: Session agent Claude, Sonnet. Change agent or model

steps.name: Launch failure retains the chosen agent
steps.goal: Tap Start session once. The isolated demo intentionally returns no session id and starts no real work. Do not tap it again.
steps.done: The launch error keeps the finding and chosen session settings visible.
